static_traits.name: Lin Anqi
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive wife and a few close friends, but has not yet discussed unease and diet concerns with them; busy Work limits socializing and emotional sharing
static_traits.medical_history: No obvious physical illness; no history of similar psychological problems or psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic; Anxious and pessimistic tone; harsh on oneself, experiencing shame and embarrassment; overall cooperative, willing to try small changes

basic_info.main_problem: I constantly feel hungry and worry that my eating habits will lead to obesity.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent worry about diet and weight gain has affected mood, energy, and family life, so decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: A few months ago, Lin Anqi's Work Stress significantly increased; long overtime hours and high-intensity management duties led to Physical and mental exhaustion, followed by persistent hunger and increased appetite. She began worrying that eating would lead to obesity, a worry especially severe on A busy workday; after work and on weekends she was more prone to overeating and felt Anxiety and guilt. She tried various diet and exercise plans, but the Work pace made them hard to sustain, and the experience of failure further intensified feelings of 'loss of control' and 'doomed to fail'. Meanwhile, although she has a supportive wife and friends, she has not proactively shared these concerns out of shame and 'fear of burdening others', leaving support resources not yet effectively used.

special_situations.event: Returning home after a busy Work day, Physical and mental exhaustion with Anxiety, facing dinner or snacks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I feel intense hunger or eat more than planned, it means I am losing control, and my weight will inevitably go out of control
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Makes strict diet/exercise plans trying to regain control; when tense, eats to temporarily relieve stress
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once I eat a bit more, I will get fatter and fatter, sooner or later I will become obese

special_situations.event: A week of unusually busy work, hunger and appetite increase
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Whenever pressure comes, my eating inevitably gets out of control
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids talking about troubles with others, toughs it out alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely gain a lot of weight this week; I cannot control it

special_situations.event: Not yet able to stick to a diet/exercise plan as scheduled because Work interrupted
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perfectly stick to the plan, it equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Either go all out executing a high-intensity plan, or give up completely
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I failed again; it shows I simply cannot do it

special_situations.event: Low mood when spending time with family due to Anxiety about diet and weight
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not doing well, I will burden my family and disappoint them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing expression of true feelings to wife, avoiding discussing unease and diet issues

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be understood and supported, while hoping to regain a sense of control over one's body and diet
core_conflict.fear: Fears exposing vulnerability will burden others, be judged, or draw disappointed looks
defense_goal: Avoiding becoming a burden and Being rejected by not expressing needs
Suppressing Anxiety and the sense of losing control through self-control (strict dieting / plans)

object_relations.self_representation: A shameful, possibly out-of-control person who drags others down
object_relations.object_representation: Others who are supportive but may be dragged down by me or disappointed in me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests sharing stress and unease with wife, or probes her sense of shame
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equates expressing needs with 'troubling the other person', worrying about being disliked or disappointing one's wife
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Restrained and objective tone, emphasizing 'not wanting to trouble her / she is busy', discussing facts and arrangements instead of expressing feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the emotional experience behind eating (e.g. shame, helplessness)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views emotional experience as dangerous or embarrassing, believes once touched one will lose control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Switching to discussing diet plans, calories, or Work arrangements, using a rational analytical tone, avoiding emotional words.

manifestations: Not sharing diet and weight concerns with wife and friends, worrying about burdening others
Tends to bear it alone under pressure and shame
outcomes: Accumulating Anxiety and shame, support resources not yet used

manifestations: Long working hours limit self-care choices and life rhythm
A strong fear of 'losing control over body / eating'
outcomes: A sense of losing control and compulsive control swing between strict planning and giving up
Intensified cycle of emotional eating and guilt

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Repeatedly worrying 'I will drag my wife down', experiencing shame and not daring to speak up
In counseling, cautiously evaluates whether each step is 'appropriate', avoiding expressing needs directly

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Choosing to bear pressure alone when needing support, not asking wife for help
Deals with tension through eating, guilt, and self-blame rather than connecting outward

positive_force: Having a supportive spouse and a few close friends (potential Social support)
Able to recognize that some worries have not yet come true, with some reality-testing ability
Willing to try small-step actions and behavioral experiments, motivation and cooperation are good
Has a stable occupation and basic self-discipline ability, providing conditions for structured change
negative_force: Long-term high pressure and overtime cause physical and mental exhaustion, triggering emotional eating
Cognitive biases like catastrophizing, predicting the future, overgeneralization, and personalization sustaining Anxiety
Shame and the belief of 'fearing to burden others' leading to avoiding help-seeking, support resources not yet used
All-or-nothing control strategies making plans hard to sustain, intensifying the failure-and-guilt cycle
Guilt and self-blame about eating in turn increase stress, forming a vicious cycle of 'stress - eating - guilt'

target_behavior.behavior: Emotional eating (eating excessively / frequently after stress)
antecedent: Feeling exhausted and Anxious after busy Work days
Weekends and evening times of Being alone or relaxing
Unusually busy work causes increased hunger and tension
target_behavior.core_reason: Work stress triggering Anxiety and bodily hunger experiences, sustained by the catastrophic Interpretation of 'getting out of control and becoming obese', triggering the cycle of 'eating relief - guilt - more tension'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncomfortable emotions and gaining brief comfort and relaxation
target_behavior.consequence: Weight and appearance Anxiety intensified, increased Low mood and guilt, disrupted sleep and self-care, Tense family relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids expressing needs and shame to the wife / friends (absence of help-seeking behavior)
antecedent: Shame and embarrassment when thinking about discussing diet and weight worries
Worrying about troubling the other person or being judged
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by core beliefs of avoiding becoming a burden and being negated, with shame reinforcing self-enclosure
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible rejection and negative evaluation; maintains surface control and interpersonal safety
target_behavior.consequence: Support resources not yet used, Sense of isolation and Anxiety persisting, eating problems and Emotional distress persisting
